references.label: drop targets
references.description: While the launch ball save runs, attack the left drop targets.

references.label: left drop bank
references.description: Use the left drop bank to qualify Riot and collect all three Supplies, then prepare Prison and Tower 2x.

references.label: Supply drop bank
references.description: The three drop targets are on the left-middle side below the left ramp.

references.label: left orbit
references.description: Complete the left drop bank to light Dead Features, then shoot the left orbit to start Barn.

references.label: Left ramp and CDC
references.description: The long left ramp begins on the left side beside the Supply drops.

references.label: pop bumpers
references.description: Opening feed: The plunge enters the pop bumpers.

references.label: Prison bash toy
references.description: The Prison doors and Walker head are straight up the center near the top.

references.label: Prison shot
references.description: Score 12 Prison jackpots across two Prison Multiballs to spell P-R-I-S-O-N twice, then make the next Prison shot to start Siege.

references.label: right ramp
references.description: Collect Weapons during single-ball play, shoot the lit right ramp to load the Crossbow, and press the action button to fire.

references.label: Riot/Tower shot
references.description: The Riot/Tower shot runs beside the Prison and can reach the upper Tower target.

references.label: Riot/Tower shot
references.description: The Riot/Tower shot runs beside the Prison and can reach the upper Tower target.

references.label: Tower shot
references.description: A strong Riot/Tower shot starts about 30 seconds of 2x playfield scoring.

references.label: Woodbury lane
references.description: Woodbury is the upper-right lane below the right ramp return.
